title: RunManifest
description: The declared, authoritative list of run-record files that constitute one print — written once at publish time to data/runs/<print_id>/index.json. A reader must load run records by this list, never by listing the directory: the directory can hold leftover files from an earlier failed attempt under the same print_id (a same-day retry runs into the same directory), and only this manifest states which files were actually used to compute the print.

basket_version.description: Basket version, e.g. SIU-2026a — matches Print.version for the same print.

run_records.description: Filenames only (e.g. "<run_id>.json"), resolved relative to this manifest's own directory. Sorted, so the file is stable and diffable.
